notes: HOTFIX: on cold load of /admin/checklist or /ql/checklist, phf-checklist-app.js's top-level CHECKLIST_TEMPLATE_OPTIONS init eagerly called templateCatalog() -> ensureChecklistTemplatesHydrated() -> hydrateChecklistTemplatesFromDatabase(data) BEFORE the module-level var checklistTemplateDbState was initialized (var hoisting: name hoisted, assignment not yet run). If window.__phfLocalData was already populated at that instant (a race against the lazy route-module fetch in phf-url-router.js), this threw TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'hydratedSource'), aborting the whole IIFE before window.phfRenderChecklist could be assigned - so waitForRouteModule's poll in phf-url-router.js timed out with PHF_CHECKLIST_RENDERER_TIMEOUT, shown to the user as 'Chưa thể mở Checklist'. F5 usually avoided it only because the already-cached script executes before the fresh /api/data fetch resolves. Fix: moved the checklistTemplateDbState and CUSTOM_TEMPLATE_STORAGE_KEY declarations above the eager CHECKLIST_TEMPLATE_OPTIONS computation so the state object exists before any consumer can read it - a pure ordering fix, no timeout/optional-chaining/try-catch changes.
